briefdescription.para: Mode for ending a debug session.

detaileddescription.para:
Maps to dbgeng DEBUG_END_* flags. Choose based on target state:
terminate: target is alive, kill it on detach
detach: target is alive, leave it running
passive: target has already exited; release session state only

briefdescription.para: launch or attach request sent; waiting for first CreateProcess event.
Target is executing. Resume/step have been issued.
Target is paused at a breakpoint, step completion, or exception.
Target process has exited. Session is shutting down.
Execution lifecycle states for the debug target.

detaileddescription.para: Represents the coarse state machine of a debug session as seen by the DAP layer. Transitions are driven by Session and surfaced to Whatdbg via processDeferredEvents.

briefdescription.para: Lifecycle phase of the dbgeng loader/initial breakpoint.

detaileddescription.para: Three-state machine, transitioned by EventCallbacks::Breakpoint and consumed by processDeferredEvents/addPendingBreakpointsAndResume.

listitem.para: notHit — dbgeng has not yet raised the initial loader breakpoint.
pending — loader breakpoint fired; resolve+resume not yet run.
resolved — initial break consumed; subsequent breakpoints are user BPs.
found — symbol found; Session::getOffset returns the resolved address.
notFound — symbol not resolvable (no code at this line, or module not loaded).
engineBusy — engine transient error (E_UNEXPECTED); caller should retry later.

briefdescription.para: Packed (engineId, resolvedLine) pair returned by getBreakpoint.

detaileddescription.para: engineId is 0 when the engine has not assigned a breakpoint ID. resolvedLine is 0 when the engine has not resolved a source line.

briefdescription.para: Translate a platform-native exception/signal code to a human-readable name.

detaileddescription.para: Windows: code is an NTSTATUS / SEH exception code (e.g., 0xC0000005 → "ACCESS_VIOLATION"). macOS: code is a POSIX signal number / Mach exception mapping (e.g., 11 → "EXC_BAD_ACCESS").
Implementations live in platform-specific files: Callbacks.cpp on Windows, Session_mac.cpp on macOS. Used by Whatdbg::processDeferredEvents and handleExceptionInfo to build the DAP exceptionId field.

simplesect.para: Human-readable name, or "0x<hex>" fallback if the code is not known.

briefdescription.para: Attempt to pretty-print an SBValue using its known type name.

detaileddescription.para: Dispatches to type-specific formatters for types such as juce::String and std::unique_ptr. Returns empty if the type is not recognized — callers should fall back to SBValue::GetValue() / SBValue::GetSummary().

parameterdescription.para: The SBValue to format. May be mutated by child walks.

simplesect.para: Formatted display string, or empty if the type is not recognized.
